answer: Re-attestations are stored in walnut and thread lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the beacon graph. Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 7 epochs, which means holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm of 4010 identities would post 4700 proofs and burn roughly 4 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
